layers.name: micro chops
layers.description: Samples chopped into very small fragments for rhythmic texture

layers.name: phrase chops
layers.description: Longer phrase samples sliced for hook and vocal sections

layers.name: reverse chops
layers.description: Reversed audio samples for atmospheric and transition effects

layers.name: vocal chops
layers.description: Vocal samples sliced and rearranged for melodic and rhythmic effect

layers.name: stutter chops
layers.description: Rapid repeated sample fragments for build-ups and hooks

sound_intent.overall_timbre: Dark and gritty with aggressive tone
sound_intent.spatialization: Moderate stereo width with focused center on bass and drums

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic foundation with chopped sample techniques

ai_designer.brief: Manage overall arrangement, transitions, and energy shaping following sparse verses and strong hook dynamics
